description: This file defines core structures and methods for handling JSON Web Tokens (JWT), including token creation, signing, verification, and encoding.

classes.name: VerificationKey
classes.description: Interface representing a public or secret key for verifying a token's signature.

classes.name: VerificationKeySet
classes.description: A set of verification keys used to verify a JWT.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a JWT token with fields for raw token string, method, header, claims, signature, and validity status.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new JWT token with a specified signing method and optional claims.

methods.name: NewWithClaims
methods.description: Creates a new JWT token with specified signing method and claims.

methods.name: SignedString
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT string using the specified key.

methods.name: SigningString
methods.description: Generates the signing string for the token.

methods.name: EncodeSegment
methods.description: Encodes a byte segment into a base64url string without padding.
